summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce FDA acceptance of its Formal Dispute Resolution appeal, concluding the agency found substantial evidence of effectiveness for ONS-5010/LYTENAVA (bevacizumab-vikg) for nAMD after a December 2025 Complete Response Letter. The company plans a Class 1 BLA resubmission in June 2026. No merger, tender, spin-off, or other special situation is involved; this is a regulatory event. The filing updates shareholders on the FDA pathway but does not constitute a change-of-control, capital return, or activist campaign. Watch for labeling negotiations and resubmission timing.
